des: Create a .mcp_server_settings.json file in the data directory; you can pick MCP services from below or add your own.
We will keep testing and adding useful MCP services; contributions are welcome.
Remember to remove the comment lines; the des attribute is only a description and is not parsed.
The des and link attributes only describe how to install and point to the original link; they are optional.
Three transport modes are currently supported: stdio (standard input/output), sse (Server-Sent Events), streamable-http (streaming HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Uses the Streamable HTTP transport mode, suitable for production web deployments
